11th Level Clan Feature

[Main Branch]

Your strikes are refined by the focus instilled into you by the main branch. Your strikes reaches deep into your foe, bludgeoning their internal organs. When you deal [Unarmed Damage] to a creature as a result of the Attack action with ranks of Sealed or Network Distortion you can dispel all ranks they have forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failed save the affected creature is Staggered. They suffer a -1 penalty to their save for every 2 ranks of either condition dispelled in total. Once your use this feature you cannot do so again until the end of your next turn.
